_readme: Per-character combat skills. THERE IS ONE WAY TO LEARN ONE AND unlockLevel IS NOT IT: a non-book skill authors either 1 (the starting kit, and every monster ability) or 999 (unreachable on purpose -- something else hands it over: a reward track UnlockSkill node, or a talent grantsSkillId). Anything in between is refused by SkillEntryResolver and by ContentDatabase.Validation, naming the skill. The ladder is gone because a ladder PLUS a track is two systems handing out the same skill at two different moments with no rule about which wins (docs/handoffs/progression_v2/PLAN_PROGRESSION_V2.md section 1, contract 6). A bookOnly skill authors NO unlockLevel at all -- with one exception, and it is the one most likely to be got wrong. A bookOnly skill is never granted by the level ladder; a reward track may still name one. It belongs to whoever LEARNED it, not to whoever it was authored against. characterId on a book records who it was drafted for and nothing else -- all four book spells say 'sheep' because Shawn is who they were written for -- while run.learnedSpells records who actually bought it, and that is what a fight reads (ContentDatabase.AvailableSkillsFor). The shop has always offered a book to whoever is buying; this is that promise kept on the other end. Edit this file, then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. These are DIFFERENT from spells.json: that is one global power curve every character shares, which only changes the name and number of the single Skill button; these are a character's own kit, shown as their own row of buttons in a fight. Damage is (Attack, scaled by the caster's own weapon or spell scaling depending on scalingAxis, + flatAmount + power x (resource spent), minus the target's Defense unless ignoresDefense is set, floored at 1) x10 â€” health pools are on a x10 scale and stat-derived damage is scaled to match (CombatMath.DamageScale). damageInstances is the exception: a list of {type, amount} packets written directly on the final scale and NOT multiplied, each one checked against the target's weakness and resistance on its own, so one cast can land at +50% and -50% at the same time â€” 25 Fire + 25 Frost against something that resists Frost and burns to Fire is 37 + 12, not 50 of something averaged. Mana restores are flatAmount + power x (resource spent). Heals are that PLUS the caster's Wisdom: half a percent of the caster's own max health per point of Wisdom above 10 (CombatMath.WisdomHealBonus), floored at neutral so a caster with no authored ability scores -- every monster -- heals exactly what it authored. That percentage shape is what lets one heal read sensibly at both ends of the game: Woolgathering (40 flat + 2 a wool, 4 wool, cooldownTurns 2) lands about 52 on a fresh Shawn (WIS 12, ~400 max health) and about 198 -- a fifth of the bar -- on a level-60 build that actually bought Wisdom (WIS 40, ~1000 max health). Both anchors are pinned literally in WoolgatheringHealTests. A skill must cost SOMETHING (manaCost and/or resourceCost); power scales per point actually spent, so a skill with power but no resource cost is rejected rather than silently scaling by zero. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.

skills.description: Deal {nature} damage plus 6. Costs 3 wool.
Heal 48 HP plus a Wisdom bonus. Costs 4 wool. {cooldown} 2.
Deal {nature} damage plus 12, ignoring defense. Costs 6 wool.
Deal 6 {earth} damage and make the target **Vulnerable** (+25% damage taken) for 1 turn. Costs 8 {mana}. {cooldown} 2.

layers._comment: The gather: the sheet's first eight frames (a dark vortex of mud closing in Shawn's hand), tinted matte brown. The old gold glints read as fire; tint is the one field that moves it to mud.
The glob, thrown: held in the hand for 0.17 s, then 0.155 s along an arc to the body, so it arrives on the 0.325 s cue. The painted glob (mud_glob recipe): matte brown as drawn, no tint, no glow.
The payoff: the painted splat, on the body with the sound, the number and the Vulnerable badge. One still, held and then faded, matte brown as drawn.
Clots thrown up and falling back: heavy, short-lived, brown in the pixels (an emitter takes no tint).

skills.description: Deal 4 {fire} and 4 {ice} damage. Costs 7 {mana}.

layers._comment: Fire and ice meet at the target, not a bolt: f0 loose embers and shards gather, f1 is the spiral with a white core (fire arms left, ice arms right) closing on one point, f4 is the collision (flames left, shards right), f5 the residue. The sheet's vertical spear (f2, f3) is not played: a column on the target reads as lightning.

skills.description: Deal 5 {fire} and 5 {nature} damage to all enemies. Costs 15 {mana}. {cooldown} 3.

layers._comment: One ground sequence along the rank, timed so the quiet part is the crack widening (f0-f3, 0.2167 s) and the rupture (f4) opens on the hit cue, then it cools through f8.
Starts at the tallest, widest frame (f4, 1.25x the old ramp's peak) with a punch and glow: one bright frame is the accent. f0-f3's small rubble and ramp are not played.
Nature: green wisps rise out of the crack (the acid wisp still of vipers_bite_particles only).

skills.description: Deal 10 {lightning} damage. Costs 11 {mana}.

layers._comment: Strike, do not ramp: two beats of sparks at the head (f0, f1) are the whole tell, 0.18 s of quiet.

The bolt arrives at full length in one frame (f3), then f4 is the single bright frame (hit cue 0.21), then a short flicker and a thin arc remnant. f7/f8's orange embers are not used: they read as fire.

skills._comment: MILESTONE A of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.1. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification.
skills.description: Give one ally a shield of 18 points plus your spell attack for 2 turns. Costs 7 {mana}. {cooldown} 2.

layers._comment: The delivery: a white-gold mote (procedural, tools/make_spell_fx.py aegis_mote) leaves Shawn's middle and flies to the ally's middle in 0.2 s, so the ward visibly goes from him to them. Eases into the ally (the shards open as it arrives). On a self-cast it has nowhere to travel and shows as a bright point on Shawn.
Gilt leaves and glints shed along the mote's flight.

The encasing: the four shards (f0-f4) close around the ally from 0.1 s as the mote arrives, 25 fps, so f4 is the last drawing before the cue. Dim so the lock-in is the bright thing; no fade, so the lock frame replaces it on the cue.
The payoff: the painted lock, the closed gilt shield with its open centre, on the cue with the sound and the ward bar. Held, then faded; the ally stays visible through the centre.
A soft gold ring flared around the lock for 0.08 s on the cue (clear inside, so the ally's face stays visible): the lock frame is the cast's biggest rise over the dim shards and mote.
lifeMin/lifeMax tightened to 0.22/0.4 so the last leaf clears with the sprite's fade.

skills._comment: MILESTONE A, section 2.2. Frost resolves to DamageType.Ice -- Frost is a skills.json-only alias (SkillEntryResolver). appliesStatus Chilled is the FIRST content row in the game to author it, and it only slows anyone because ApplySkillStatus now goes through FightSession.ApplyStatusTo (plan D6). statusDuration 2 means two of the target's turns fully affected, the turn-end clock plan D1 put every standing modifier on.
skills.description: Deal 6 {ice} damage and make the target **Chilled** (-25% speed) for 2 turns. Costs 8 {mana}. {cooldown} 2.

layers._comment: Owner 2026-10-02 budget: the hang is 0.2 s, and large and bright enough to read as frost forming. f0 swirl then f1 crystal cluster in the air between caster and target.

f4's spear, fired from the same air point at the target's middle. Painted pointing 26 degrees up (measured: principal axis of f4's alpha), so orient path turns it down onto the flight; impactX/Y is the point 80% of the way from the frame centre to the tip, so the tip buries itself in the body rather than stopping at its surface. Arrival 0.26 + 0.2 = 0.46 is the hit cue.
f5's starburst on contact, held briefly on the struck body.

The collapse (2026-09-25, SPELL_VFX_ARC_AUDIT): opens as the impact still clears and plays f8 (settling frost cloud) -> f9 (thinning mist column) -> f10 (thin ground ring), three frames fitted into 0.27 s, then a 0.13 s fade -- gone 0.56 s after the hit. Stood on the ground line (place target) with the ring's measured ellipse centre as its impact point: in the sliced f10 the ring spans x 37-274, y 194-293 of 314, centre (155.5, 243.5) -> impactX 0.5, impactY 0.22 from the bottom, so the ring circles the feet instead of hovering at the waist.
Frost shards shed at the hit. lifeMax 0.5 so the last one is gone inside the tear's fade (0.43-0.56 s after the hit) rather than outliving the collapse.

skills._comment: MILESTONE A, section 2.3. The Poison-typed packet detonates whatever Poison the target already carries -- ALL of it, in one consumption, since Poison stacks (StatusCombos.SpendPoisonIfMatched) -- and the fresh Poison below lands afterwards, on a live target only, so the cast can never re-detonate what it just applied. The description is the tooltip and is worded exactly as the plan specifies.
skills.description: Deal 3 {poison} damage and set off all **Poison** already on the target, then apply 3 Poison for 3 turns. Costs 7 {mana}. {cooldown} 2.

layers._comment: A snake eye opening in the dark inside the bite (vipers_bite_eyes: half open, then open), held to the cue: same anchor as the jaws, one eye each side of the gap between them. Tinted down to a sickly acid green and dimmed so it smoulders; small so the cue stays the biggest rise.

A snake eye opening in the dark inside the bite (vipers_bite_eyes: half open, then open), held to the cue: same anchor as the jaws, one eye each side of the gap between them. Tinted down to a sickly acid green and dimmed so it smoulders; small so the cue stays the biggest rise.

The jaws form on the body: the ghost-jaw sheet's f0-f4 (round 2 atlas jaws, seen from the front), the two halves drawing together and the fangs showing. Dim (glow 0.7, under the snap's 1.25) so the snap is the bright thing. No snake head.
The snap: the ghost-jaw sheet's f5, the jaws shut in a green starburst, alone on the cue with the sound, the number and the Poison badge.
The jaws shut with the fangs in (f6, f7), fading as the venom starts to run.
Resolution: venom runs down the body (four cells thinning, hung from their top edge on the bite).
lifeMin/lifeMax tightened to 0.22/0.42 so the last particle clears with the sprite's fade.
Resolution: green mist off the bite, thinning (the acid wisp frames, low opacity).

THE SECOND PAYOFF, only when the bite spent Poison the target already carried: the painted venom burst, a plume and a crown of droplets rising off the body at detonationSeconds after the cue, with its own number and its own sound. Sized to 220 so the plume does not cover the whole body (contract 2).
The detonation's spray: the acid wisp (frames 3 and 4), bigger and faster than the settle shed, with the pop.

skills._comment: MILESTONE B of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.4. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. consumesStatus/damageInstancesIfConsumed read and spend the GENERAL Marked status (Marks.cs), never the Drowned Lantern's own private mark set.
skills.description: Deal 7 {arcane} damage, or 12 if the target is **Marked** (this removes the Mark). Costs 6 {mana}.

layers._comment: Crownfall by name: the crown assembles in the air directly above the target (f0-f4, 0.22 s) and then falls straight down onto it.

The fall: f5's crown-on-a-spike (painted tip down) is dropped from one body-height over the body's middle and falls straight onto it. place above + travelSeconds is the fall, so it takes 0.14 s on a rat and a treant alike; the ease into contact is the layer's own. The tip (impactX 0.47, impactY 0.045 of the 314 frame) lands on the middle, where the shatter opens at the hit.
f6-f11, the shatter and the settling motes, played on the struck body from the hit.

skills._comment: MILESTONE B of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.5. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. requiresStatus/detonationPercent/detonationSplit build the Reclaim effect's whole damage from a consumed Poison pile; see StatusCombos.SpendPoisonIfMatched and ConsumedTotalSplit. No damageInstances of its own -- the packets are computed at resolution.
skills.description: Needs a **Poisoned** target. Remove its Poison and deal 150% of the damage it had left as {poison} and {fire} damage, then make it **Vulnerable** (+20% damage taken) for 1 turn. Costs 10 {mana}. {cooldown} 2.

layers._comment: WIND-UP, 0.6 s: the target's venom drawn into a vortex (ashen_reckoning_venom_vortex, 5 cells). It BUILDS: it fades in over 0.4 s, gets brighter (glowCurve) and turns ever faster (rotate: a rising quarter sine, at rest at the start, fastest on the cue, 150 degrees in all) while the cells, baked 1.3x to 0.9x in the recipe, draw it inward. Ends on the cue with no fade; venom_hold carries the last cell across.
CATCH, the green going out: the last vortex cell (the dense knot) held 0.05 s on the cue and faded over 0.2 s while the fire grows inside it, so the green gives way instead of cutting.

CATCH, FIRST PACKET (Poison): the venom ignites. Catch cell 1 (a small core of flame), opening on the cue with the first number (an impact: appearing instantly is the intended exception), oversized and settling (punch). catch_b and catch_c grow the ring outward from it; the ring is 0.61 of its box. Authored at release, offset from the cue, because an at: hit still is capped at 0.75 of the body (TargetBody.TailMaxOfBody).
CATCH: the flame spreads outward from the core (catch cell 2, a ring of tongues).

CATCH: the ring at its widest (catch cell 3), about the body's width, then it fades into the campfire. Catch cell 4 (a flat ellipse on the ground) is not played: after the upright hoop it reads as a perspective pop.
SECOND PACKET (Fire), one stagger step behind: a flare-up as fuel is added. The widest ring again, hotter, for 0.06 s, with the second number and the second clip.
The venom's drops, with the first packet.
Embers and flame tongues thrown by the fire, with the second packet (the censer's particle frames f0, f2, f3: coal, ash wisp, flame; no rock).
ENDING, step 1: the campfire takes at the feet as the burst fades, breathing.
ENDING, step 2: smaller and dimmer.
ENDING, step 3: low, flickering hard.
ENDING, step 4, the gutter: a few low flames, no glow, flickering deeply until they die.
ENDING: bright coals float up while the fire is strong.
ENDING: the embers dim: fewer, half the glow.
ENDING: the last embers, dull, no glow.
ENDING: ash falls, flat grey flakes (the ashen sheet's grey shard f2), readable.

skills._comment: MILESTONE B of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.6. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. healthCostPercent is validated together with manaCost and paid directly (HealthCost), never through the damage funnel. ignoresDefense depends on the milestone B repair to ResolveDamageInstances (plan 1.3) -- without it this packet's bypass is inert.
skills.description: Deal 13 {void} damage, ignoring defense. Costs 12 {mana} and 5% of your max HP. {cooldown} 3.

layers._comment: The shards gather into the spear in the air between caster and target over 0.6 s: f0-f2, held in the sky (SpellFlight.SkyPoint), sized to the target's body.

The tear along the path: the painted tear still (blackglass_spear_rift, a dark void with violet glow and shards) laid along the spear's flight from the air point through the target's middle to where the spear leaves the stage, stretched to it, revealed behind the spear as it flies, then held 0.2 s from its opening and faded over 0.15 s, so it is a brief streak that is gone almost as the spear leaves the stage. Thickness is size 170 on a rat. Authored before the spear so the spear draws over it.

Speed lines: thin violet streaks (speed_streak, baked by ProceduralSpriteBaker) born along the spear's flight, turned onto it and scattered across its width, each living 0.10-0.20 s so the line of them is gone almost as soon as the spear has passed. Authored before the spear so it draws over them. The window covers the approach and the flight on through the target.

f3's spear (the cleanest: alpha axis 20x longer than wide), fired from the air point at the target's middle. Painted pointing 45 degrees down, so orient path turns it by only a few degrees onto the flight. impactX/Y is 80% of the way from the frame centre to the tip. Fired at 0.6 once the build-up has gathered; arrival 0.6 + 0.1 = 0.7 is the hit cue. `through` keeps it flying at its arrival speed along the same line until it is off the stage.
The hard flash as the spear fires: f5 on the air point at the instant the spear leaves, so the build-up ends in a bang rather than a fade.
The rent left where it fired: f9 (shards in void haze) held on the air point and gone in 0.3s, the near end of the tear along the path.
f5's flash on contact, held briefly on the struck body.

The tear seals (2026-09-25, SPELL_VFX_ARC_AUDIT): opens as the impact still clears on the struck body's centre and plays f9 (shards in void haze) dissolving into f10 (the void contracted to one spark), two frames fitted into 0.5 s, then a 0.45 s fade -- a lingering seal, gone 0.66 s after it opens.
Glass splinters shed at the hit. lifeMax 0.46 so the last one is gone inside the tear's fade (0.40-0.52 s after the hit) rather than outliving the seal.

skills._comment: MILESTONE C of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.7. Every number here is marked prototype in that document and is tuning, not specification. advanceSlots is measured in PLACES, not in charge -- one slot moves past one charge LEVEL, so two combatants tied at a level are jumped together and a slot with nobody above it clips (plan 1.9). No damage, no status, nothing left on the board: the whole cast is a position. It is refused outright, before payment, when the chosen ally is already next in the order.
skills.description: Move an ally up to 2 places earlier in the turn order. Costs 8 {mana}. {cooldown} 2.

layers._comment: The turning: the hourglass in its ring (f0-f4) spins up on the ally for 0.3 s. Dim, so the cue is the bright thing; no fade, so the starburst replaces it on the cue.

The payoff: the painted forward chevrons on the ally on the cue, with the sound, the log line and the tracker moving the ally up, then slid forward and faded: a step taken early. The art points right and mirrors with the cast.
Sand grains and glints thrown up off the ally; gravity pulls UP, so they quicken as they go.

skills._comment: MILESTONE C, section 2.8. queuePushSlots on a DamageAll row is NEW: the AOE branch applied status but never the push until this milestone, so the resolver refused the field on anything but DamageSingle and now accepts it on either damage effect. The delay is batched AFTER every enemy has resolved and every death has settled, over landed-hit survivors only -- a dodger keeps its place (plan 1.9 rule 6). Wind 5 per enemy, each checked against that enemy's own affinity.
skills.description: Deal 5 {wind} damage to all enemies. Each enemy hit loses 1 place in the turn order. Costs 11 {mana}. {cooldown} 3.

layers._comment: The quiet before the cut: the sheet's first four frames (a small whirl closing) in Shawn's hand for 0.2 s, and nothing on the enemies yet.

The sweep: the painted blade laid along the line of struck bodies (align span, past the end bodies by overhang) and carried across it from the caster's side outward in the 0.1 s before the cue. One long cut, drawn at the proportion it was painted at. Decorative; the damage is the shared payoff on the cue.

The payoff on every body at once: the same blade drawn across each enemy on the cue, so every number lands under the same frame. It replaces the old sheet's three tornado whorls; a shorter blade than the sweep so three of them are not a wall over the numbers.

skills._comment: MILESTONE C, section 2.9. TWO PICKS, and the count is NOT authored: SkillEffects.PicksRequired reads it off the effect, because one more content number would let a row ask for three picks no resolution can use (plan 2.9). freeAction true is the caster's one free action a turn, the same lock Tuck In already uses. Either ally being Rooted refuses the cast before payment, the identical rule CanMove/Move read off both sides.
skills.description: Move an ally to any seat, swapping with whoever is there. Neither may be **Rooted**. Free action. Costs 7 {mana}. {cooldown} 3.

layers._comment: seconds 0.72 -> 0.66: the recipe dropped from 12 to 11 frames (v2 cell 12 omitted, near-empty). fps 0 fits the folder into seconds, so 11 x 0.06 = 0.66 keeps hitCueSeconds 0.3 landing on the same cell 6 it hit at 12 frames instead of drifting to 0.327.
The same doors on the seat the traveller swaps with. The stage paints the swap at the 0.3 s cue (CombatBeat.PlacementHoldSeconds 0), behind both.

aimDegrees 90 -> 270 (downward): the tail frames show the doors closing/shrinking, not an upward burst -- an upward particle spray after they vanish read as a second effect. lifeMin/lifeMax tightened to 0.22/0.42 so the last particle clears before the sprite's fade (ends 0.66 + 0.14 = 0.8) finishes.

skills._comment: MILESTONE D, section 2.10. SkillEffect.Afflict: one enemy, this row's authored status, no damage -- so there is no damage instance, AfterDefences is never entered and the root cannot be dodged. statusDuration 2 is two EFFECTIVE turns under the milestone-A duration model (Rooted is AtTurnEnd, so the second turn's action is still restricted). The root now forbids every action classified physicalMove, on both sides, plus the formation Move it always forbade (plan 1.10). No scaling of any kind: a two-turn root is two turns from anyone, which is what keeps this a control spell rather than a damage spell in disguise.
skills.description: **Root** one enemy for 2 turns. It cannot make physical attacks or move. Costs 9 {mana}. {cooldown} 3.

layers._comment: ANTICIPATION: gold thread tufts shed at Shawn's hand as the ribbon is drawn.

DELIVERY: one ribbon lashed from Shawn's hand to the target (orient path, strip painted pointing +x), 0.20 s across. It hands over to the two wrap layers as it lands (they fade in over 0.04 s, it fades out over 0.06 s).

WRAP, BACK: the ribbon band behind the legs, tilted +10 degrees. Frames f0-f4 pull it tight from 1.30x to 1.0x (f4 on the cue, 0.40 s), f5 holds, f6-f7 go slack and the layer fades. Ground band (holds 2); Velvet Shackles hits one body, so one ground layer is safe.
WRAP, FRONT: the same strip tilted the other way, over the legs, so the two bands cross like a binding. Same frames and clock as `back`.

PAYOFF: the cuff cinches at the feet, sized to the legs, not the body. f0 open (0.30 s), f1 nearly closed (0.35 s), f2 closed with the gold clasp on the cue (0.40 s); held to 0.62 s and faded over 0.2 s. E9 (a cuff that stays as the Root visual) is not built, so it fades here.
PAYOFF: a gold glint off the clasp on the cue.
RESOLUTION: ribbon curls and scraps settle as the bands go slack.

skills.description: Apply **Burn** (4 damage per turn) to one enemy for 3 turns. Costs 8 {mana}. {cooldown} 2.

layers._comment: Wind-up, 1.0 s by the owner's call: the painted censer (censer_hanging) is pulled back to the left and released: held at its left extreme while it fades in (0.2 s), then left to right to left, each swing a little larger (damping -0.4), a plain cosine so it is fastest at the bottom and slows toward the ends, breaking at the far left on the cue. It hangs from a pivot 4.5 box heights up (1250 px to the lantern), so it travels a wide arc: 9.5 degrees at the start, 13.1 at the break. Unfitted: one size on every body, over the crown of a tall one.
Wind-up: smoke leaves the lantern's body as the censer swings and hangs where it was born (almost still), so the path of the swing is drawn in the air behind the lantern.
Wind-up: sparks flung from the lantern's right rim along the swing as the censer lets go (0.2 s).
Wind-up: sparks flung from the left rim back along the swing as it turns at the right extreme (0.6 s).

Payoff: the censer breaks. Its own still, drawn exactly where the swinging layer is on the cue (same pivot, the same angle at 1.0 s), brighter for 0.04 s and gone in 0.05 s; no scale punch, because a scale about a pivot this far away moves the lantern.

Payoff: the censer explodes into a shower of embers thrown out in every direction and falling under gravity, born at the lantern's centre (sourceDy -50 on the censer's art, carried to wherever the swing has put it). They glow, so they bloom as they fall.
Payoff: a few big coals tumble out of the break, heavier than the embers.

Resolution: the owner's painted fire (censer_flame_loop, four frames that loop, the coal line on one row) catches at the feet as the embers land (0.45 s after the cue), breathing so it never holds still. Dies down over 0.12 s (a longer fade turns the yellow core olive over the dark ground) into the Burn coal glow.
Resolution: coals float up from the fire and wink out; the last one is the smallest thing on screen.
Finish: smoke rises from the fire at the feet, swells and thins out. Born while the fire lives and outlasting it, so it is the last thing on screen.
Aftermath: a few grey ash flakes (soft discs, tinted grey) drift down over the body once the embers have gone.

skills.description: Apply **Thorned** to one enemy for 3 turns: 5 {nature} damage at the start of its turn and after each physical move. Costs 10 {mana}. {cooldown} 3.

layers._comment: BACK CANES, behind the body: a bunch of canes grows on each foot in three sway pairs (f0-f5, 0.3 s), bends in and closes into a low dome on the cue (f6), is held (f6-f13 are all the dome); the layer plays 0.5 s (f0-f9) and then fades the dome out in place over 0.28 s, clear at 0.9 s, so the cage never re-opens. The dome is as wide as the target (size 341 = canvas 520 over dome 442, scaled to 290) and about as tall as wide. Ground band holds 2 renderers; this is the only ground layer. Recipe thorn_tithe_back.

FRONT CANES, in front of the body: the same rise in a lighter teal, closing into a low X across the body on the cue; fades out as `back` does. Same canvas, size and pivot as `back`, so the two register as one cage; the art is symmetric, so it is not mirrored.
ANTICIPATION: the soil cracks at the feet and throws up dust and clods (recipe thorn_tithe_crack, pivot at the crack's middle). Over by 0.3 s, before the canes are tall.
ANTICIPATION: bark flakes and clods jump with the crack.
PAYOFF: sap beads burst from the cage as it snaps shut.
RESOLUTION: a few copper leaves shaken loose by the snap fall past the body. Born on the cue, gone by 0.5 s after it (life 0.3-0.4).

skills._comment: MILESTONE F of docs/PLAN_SPELL_EXPANSION.md, section 2.13. Ordinary enemies take Fear; authored bosses use queuePushSlots as their fallback. appliesStatus is the caster's explicit price.
skills.iconPath: Assets/_Project/Art/Items/SpellBooks/Court of Whispers/Court of Whispers - Spell Book - 48x48.png
skills.description: Every non-boss enemy is **Feared** for 1 turn. Bosses lose 2 places in the turn order instead. You become **Vulnerable** (+20% damage taken) for 1 turn. Costs 14 {mana}. {cooldown} 4.

layers._comment: ORBIT, far arc, 0.00-0.40 s: a courtier fades in small and dim and drifts across the body left to right; hands off to orbit_front at the right extreme. In the effects band, so it passes OVER the body: the ground band (behind every figure) holds 2 renderers and a rack of three needs 3, so the third enemy drew no far arc (NOTES, round 1). Moving it behind is the E5 depth-band change.

ORBIT, near arc, 0.30-0.72 s, crossfading with the far arc over 0.30-0.40 s so the change of size reads as the figure coming round, not as a pop: the same courtier mirrored, full size, in front of the body, coming back right to left and slowing into the lean position. A reverse layer mirrors its drift with its art, so the authored x signs are the mirror of the path on screen (it runs +0.6 to -0.35).

PAYOFF and RESOLUTION: the painted leaning courtier takes over from the orbit at the cue, bends to the head (closest at 0.78 s; full strength on the cue at 0.70 s), then draws back out and thins. One per enemy.
Whisper motes at the payoff; a few, small.
RESOLUTION, step 1: the courtier comes apart as it draws back. Smoke curls rise from where it stood and thin.
RESOLUTION, step 2: less, smaller, higher.
RESOLUTION, last: one small curl of smoke rises and thins.
Shawn's price: a small violet wisp flickers on him, no ring. casterCostSeconds holds his Vulnerable badge for the same 0.18 s so flicker and badge arrive together.

skills.description: The target's next attack must hit you.
Deal {nature} damage plus 4 and push the target back 1 place in the turn order. Costs 2 wool.
For 3 turns: +50% attack, +30% speed, temporary HP equal to 25% of max HP, and hits also deal 50% damage to the enemies either side. Costs 7 wool. {cooldown} 5.

skills._comment: A SHIELD, not a percentage, since 2026-09-16 (AUDIT #152). flatAmount is the pool in shield points; sheep_lamb_ward_1's WardReductionPercent 40 scales it to 70 and Thicker Fleece's 60 to 80. It authored NO number at all before, because the talent used to BE the ward.
skills.description: Put a 50-point shield on you or an ally for 1 turn. Costs 2 wool. {cooldown} 2.
Break every **ward** you have out. Each one explodes on a random enemy. Costs 3 wool. {cooldown} 3.
All allies take 50% less damage for 1 turn. Costs 10 wool. {cooldown} 3.
Give an ally mana. Costs 2 wool.
An ally's next attack deals more damage. Costs 3 wool.
Move an ally to the front of the turn order. Costs 5 wool.
Shawn's fourth ability is not designed yet.
skills.placeholderNote: Reward track V4 (level 30) needs an owner-designed ability -- docs/handoffs/progression_v2/PLAN_PROGRESSION_V2.md phase 0 sign-off. PLACED ON SHAWN's TRACK at level 30 by phase 4, so the node exists on the rail and the shape of the track is real; what it grants is not designed yet, and playerSelectable false means collecting it puts nothing on his command strip. Replace this entry with the real ability rather than adding a second one beside it, or the track will grant the stand-in forever.

skills.description: Spend up to 4 wool for a 5-point shield per wool, lasting 1 turn. Free action, once per turn.
Deal damage plus 2 to one target.
skills._comment: The golem's only ability, so it plays every golem turn. Layered so the eruption lands ON the hit cue (the legacy block popped the rock 0.16 s early) behind the struck body (sort ground, so the rock bursts around the victim). A dust puff under the target 0.15 s before the hit is the quiet part that makes the pop loud. No windupStance: the golem's attack pose is the post-slam crouch (fists in rubble), so it would read as a slam already landed.

skills.description: Deal damage plus 4 to one target, ignoring defense.
Summon a Rat. No more than 2 Rats at once.
Deal damage to one target and **Stun** it for 1 turn.
Heal 2 HP and gain **Protect** for 1 turn (-50% damage taken).
Deal damage plus 2 to one target.

skills._comment: Close: the figure jumps in unposed, raises its trunk (windupStance attack, which buys a wind-up wait) and slams (trunk_slam) at the impact. vfx is the ground contact: impact_burst at the target's ground line, timed to hit.
skills.description: Deal damage plus 3 to one target.

skills._comment: No approach/windupStance authored -- Hold delivers a cast from where it stands, which is what the 'cast' pose already is. vfx: an emitter over the whole struck party (formation/level -- a footprint, not a line), drifting rather than bursting (rate+window, near-zero gravity, long life). Reuses thorn_tithe_particles (no dedicated spore art exists): weighted toward f1 (the leaf) and f3 (the green droplet, already Poison-coloured) over f0/f2's thorn shapes -- see the emitter's own weights.
skills.description: Deal damage plus 1 to all enemies and **Poison** them for 3 per turn for 3 turns.
Deal damage plus 5 to one target in the middle or rear and make it **Vulnerable** (+25% damage taken) for 1 turn. {cooldown} 2.

skills._comment: THE BELLWETHER'S KIT, M5 (docs/PLAN_BELLWETHER_KIT.md 1.3). Every turn that is not the Chains/Knell pair: a physical rake that leaves Bleed (the monster-level rider cannot carry it -- it would bleed on the knell too, plan 2.8). The most-seen effect in the kit: a six-drawing rake (lilac tips, white flash, blood) opened oversized at the hit, the flash held a beat on top with bloom, and blood drops thrown down along the swipe. The sheet arrived 3x2 with no separate flash or particle row, so the flash is a still of its frame 2 and the drops are cut by rect (recipes bellwether_scratch, bellwether_scratch_drops). M7: flatAmount 0 and Bleed 5 x 3 (was 8); the Bellwether's attack (40) carries Scratch's weight because it rides the depth rate and a flat Bleed does not.
skills.description: Deal damage to one target and inflict **Bleed** for 5 per turn for 3 turns.

skills._comment: THE BELLWETHER'S KIT, M5 (plan 1.4). Its 1st and 5th acting turns: void chains pull Shawn to the FRONT seat (Reposition toSeat 1, trading with any occupant; a Rooted target holds). No damage (plan section 7 gap-fill). The rift opens at the Bellwether, one run of chain flies at the target, and the bind wraps him on arrival -- hitCueSeconds is that arrival (0.2 + 0.32). The bind is facing none: its tails are painted trailing right, back toward the Bellwether, and mirroring would point them away from it. It plays 0.3s, the hold FightBeatPlayer.PullHoldSeconds gives a pull before the stage drags him (the layer's own `follow` is authored-only, read by nothing, so a bind cannot ride him across the stage). Worn in its 'extra' stance.
skills.description: Pull the target to the front of the line.

layers._comment: Opens in FRONT of the Bellwether, on the side facing its target: caster-centre is its castPoint (the chest front, by the bell), and the rift is painted a fifth of the way across its frame with the chains running on, so dx 130 puts the rift just past it, by the raised forward hand, and the chains out toward the target. At dy 180 off the slot's middle it sat on the far side of the body and its chains ran back through the torso (kit-m5 capture).
No offset: a travelling layer leaves the caster's castPoint -- where the rift opens -- and an offset would ride the whole flight and land it beside the target instead of on him.

Plays the six frames in 0.3 s (the snap), then holds the taut frame and rides Shawn for the 0.3 s PullHoldSeconds plus the 0.35 s glide, so the chains are still on him while he is dragged to the front.
The accent at the instant the stage starts dragging him (hit cue + CombatBeat.PullHoldSeconds): one punched, bright frame of the taut chains.

skills._comment: THE BELLWETHER'S KIT, M5 (plan 1.5). The acting turn after Dark Chains resolved: a Void hit sized by the SEAT the chained target stands in when it lands -- 130% of his max health at the front, 20% in the middle, nothing at the rear (damageBySeatMaxHpPercent, M2). ignoresDefense true by the orchestrator's call, so a defence build cannot soak a front knell; Void affinity, Protect/Vulnerable, ward and dodge still apply. A bell swings in the air over him and cracks on the hit; a void wave rolls across the floor under him from the Bellwether's side. The wave is a `target` layer rather than the plan's `formation`: a formation box spans only the STRUCK bodies, so under one lone Shawn it came out a hand's width wide and unreadable (M5 capture). M7: front 130 (not 110) so a +25 magical resistance (x0.8) alone cannot save a full-HP Shawn; middle 20 (not 35) so the second knell after Scratch wear is heavy, not a coin flip. No variance roll (FightSession.Skills: a seat-sized hit is exact).
skills.description: Deal {void} damage, ignoring defense: 130% of the target's max HP at the front, 20% in the middle, none at the rear.

layers._comment: Timed as release + 0.5 (the hit cue) rather than at: hit on purpose: a hit-timed layer on a body is a TAIL and is capped at 75% of the struck body (TargetBody.TailMaxOfBody), which drew this ground wave a hand's width wide under Shawn. The wave is meant to roll wider than he is.

skills.description: Deal damage plus 17 to one target. At 50 **Fury** or more, spend half your Fury for double damage. At 100 Fury, spend it all for quadruple damage.

skills._comment: Bellow (talents.json bear_sen_bellow_1, grantsSkillId). Reuses the Provoke effect Shawn's own kit already defines. The id keeps its placeholder_ prefix because ids are never renamed once a save can hold them. cooldownTurns 3: the number counts from the turn it was cast on, so it is 'turn N, then turn N+3'.
skills.description: **Provoke** one enemy: its next attack must target him. {cooldown} 3.

skills._comment: The Sentinel root's skill (talents.json bear_sen_root, grantsSkillId), so unlockLevel 999. The id keeps its placeholder_ prefix because ids are never renamed once a save can hold them. cooldownTurns 2, not 1: the number counts from the turn it was cast on, so 2 is 'turn N, then turn N+2' and 1 is every turn -- SkillEntryResolver refuses 1 outright as indistinguishable from none. See SkillCooldownTests.ACooldownOfTwoMeansTurnOneThenTurnThree.
skills.description: Gain a **ward** worth 20% of your max HP. {cooldown} 2.
Deal damage plus 9 to all enemies. At 50 **Fury** or more, spend half your Fury for double damage. At 100 Fury, spend it all for quadruple damage.

skills._comment: The Einherjar root's skill (talents.json bear_ein_root, grantsSkillId). Two blows at one target for no Fury and a 3-turn cooldown; every blow pays the Fury engine separately, which is the one exception to 'once per action' and the whole reason it exists -- it is the Fury builder. flatAmount 5 is a first value: two blows of 15 pay 15 Fury each at an Attack of 10.
skills.description: Hit one target twice, each hit dealing damage plus 5. {cooldown} 3.

skills._comment: Headsplitter (talents.json bear_ein_head_1). manaCost 30 is the MINIMUM: spendsAllPrimary takes every point, and power 1 adds one damage per point spent. Each 1 percent of the target's health already gone adds 1 percent (damagePerMissingHealthPercent 100), and a kill returns half the Fury it spent. flatAmount 0 on purpose: at full health and 100 Fury it lands 110 raw, under Slam's x4 (108 + gear), so it is a finisher rather than the better Slam.
skills.description: Spend all your **Fury** to deal damage plus 1 per Fury spent, and +1% damage for each 1% of the target's HP already lost. A kill refunds half the Fury spent. Needs 30 Fury.

skills._comment: Berserk (talents.json bear_ein_bers_1). A form kept up by Fury, not by turns: no `turns`, primaryDrainPerTurn 10 at each of his turn starts, and it ends when the pool is empty. Half of both defenses becomes Attack. Entering costs 50 Fury (manaCost), so a bar of exactly 50 enters and ends on his next turn: it wants 60 or more. forbidsEffects: Bellow (Provoke) and shields (Ward). spritePath is the delivered Berserk actor (Art/Characters/bear_berserk), worn from the transform beat's impact and taken off when the Fury runs out.
skills.description: Turn 50% of your defense into attack. Lose 10 **Fury** at the start of each turn; ends when Fury runs out. No **Bellow** or **Ward** while active. Costs 50 Fury.

skills._comment: Gorge (talents.json bear_jug_gorge_1). The Juggernaut's vampiric hit: one heavy physical blow that heals him for lifestealPercent of what it deals (Gorge T2 raises it to 40, T3 adds damage under half health, both skill-scoped talent rules naming this id). flatAmount 30 is a first value against Slam's 17 at 30 Fury: it is priced as a heal that also hits, not as a second Slam.
skills.description: Deal damage plus 30 to one target and heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Costs 30 Fury.

skills._comment: Unbroken (talents.json bear_jug_converge). The reset button after riding low health: regenPercentOfMaxHealth of his max health each turn and Unstoppable, both for windowTurns of his own turns. Unstoppable also stops Unyielding from firing (plan section 4). It is a heal, so Cursed Blood converts the regen.
skills.description: For 2 turns, regenerate 15% of your max HP each turn and become immune to crowd control. Costs 50 Fury.

skills._comment: Cursed Blood (talents.json bear_jug_cap), the Juggernaut's ultimate. oncePerFight, 50 Fury. For windowTurns of his own turns no heal lands on him and every one is dealt as Void damage to every enemy (FightSession.OpenCursedBlood). The id carries a bjorn_ prefix because ids are unique across content types.
skills.description: For 2 turns, healing you would receive is dealt as {void} damage to all enemies instead, up to the HP you are missing. Once per fight. Costs 50 Fury.

skills._comment: Hold the Line (talents.json bear_sen_hold_1). A party buff whose status is Fortified: statusMagnitude points of BOTH Defense and Magical Defense, for statusDuration turns. Hold the Line T2 holds it a turn longer and pays Bjorn Fury per ally hit, T3 also cleanses one debuff from each ally (skill-scoped talent rules naming this id). 15 is a first value: against Bjorn's 40 / 12 it reads as a large step in Magical Defense, and against a sheep's it is more than doubling.
skills.description: All allies gain +15 Defense and +15 Magical Defense for 2 turns. Costs 40 Fury.

skills._comment: Plant the Shield (talents.json bear_sen_converge). Takes over Brace's button: replacesSkillId names it, so a Bjorn who owns both sees only this one (ContentDatabase.AvailableSkillsFor). The shield's size, lifetime, wait and break shards are PlantedShield's (Phase 4a); this row is only the cast and its 30 Fury (a first value). The id carries no bjorn_ prefix: nothing else is called plant_the_shield.
skills.description: Plant a shield that takes blows meant for you until it breaks or 3 turns pass. Cannot be planted again for 3 turns after. Costs 30 Fury.

skills._comment: Shield Bash (talents.json bear_sen_bash_1). A DamageSingle with plantedShieldBashPercent: it needs the planted shield down, consumes it, and adds 30% of everything the shield soaked this placement to the blow. flatAmount 20 is a first value against Slam's 17: the shield is the cost, so the base sits a little above a free Slam, and the soaked share is what makes it worth planting for. Stuns the target for 1 turn. Shield Bash T2 shortens the re-place wait, T3 spills the blow onto the neighbours (skill-scoped talent rules naming this id).
skills.description: Spend the planted shield to deal damage plus 20, plus 30% of the damage it absorbed, and **Stun** the target for 1 turn.
Spend all your **Fury** to heal 1% of your max HP per Fury spent. Needs 25 Fury.
Deal 8 damage of an element you choose: {earth}, {water}, {fire} or {wind}. Costs 8 {mana}.
Heal one ally for 20 plus your spell attack. Costs 6 {mana}.

skills._comment: scalingAxis Spell, SYMMETRICALLY with Mend beside it. The asymmetry that used to be here went with the ward model (AUDIT #152, 2026-09-16): a ward is a pool of shield POINTS now, so a spell attack that passes 80 late in a career buys a bigger shield rather than an immunity -- which is the same reason Mend was always allowed to scale. Authored as section 5's '20 plus spell attack'.
skills.description: Give one ally a **ward** of 20 points plus your spell attack for 1 turn. Costs 8 {mana}.
